title: S3 presigned URL expires after an hour or a few hours even though you set expiresIn to 7 days
symptoms: ExpiredToken: The provided token has expired
Presigned link works at first, then returns 403 long before its X-Amz-Expires time
Only URLs generated in Lambda, ECS, EC2, or after AssumeRole are affected
cause: A presigned URL is only valid while the credentials that signed it are valid. Role and STS credentials expire on their own schedule, and the URL dies with them.
fix: Sign long-lived URLs with credentials that live as long as the URL, or keep URLs short and mint a fresh one on demand from your backend. For AssumeRole, raise the session duration if a few hours is enough.
affected: All S3 presigned URLs signed with IAM role, instance profile, ECS task role, Lambda execution role, or STS credentials; maximum is 7 days only for IAM user keys with SigV4
